topic: Comprehensive Audit and Reclassification of Existing Mobile Codebase
methodology: Line-by-line verification against backend V4 truth, Swift interop compatibility, test coverage, and Ponytail necessity

inventory.v4_backend_truth_alignment: PERFECT — Lat/Lon bounds validation (-90..90, -180..180) matches backend WGS84 GeoJSON schema exactly
inventory.swift_interop: EXCELLENT — compiles to clean Swift struct with double properties and distanceToKm method
inventory.rationale: Core mathematical coordinate primitive; prevents coordinate inversion errors across platforms.

inventory.v4_backend_truth_alignment: PERFECT — Earth radius R=6371.0088km matches PostGIS ST_Distance(geography) calculation exactly
inventory.test_coverage: Covered by HaversineDistanceTest with known geo-fixtures
inventory.rationale: Ensures distance to transit stops evaluates identically on iOS, Android, and Web.

inventory.v4_backend_truth_alignment: PERFECT — Bounding box lat 17.8..22.6, lon 81.3..87.5 matches backend RegionalBoundaries.ODISHA_BBOX
inventory.swift_interop: EXCELLENT — static constants and contains() method
inventory.rationale: Essential zero-cost query guard to detect out-of-state telemetry without hitting backend API.

inventory.v4_backend_truth_alignment: PERFECT — Walk bands (<=800m Reasonable, <=1500m Short Auto, >1500m Cab) match docs/v4/MAPS_AND_TRANSPORT.md exactly
inventory.rationale: Enforces critical truth invariant: returns null when isRealGps is false to avoid misleading walking advice.

inventory.v4_backend_truth_alignment: PERFECT — Indian Standard Time (IST / UTC+05:30) schedule departure sorting and frequency evaluation
inventory.swift_interop: EXCELLENT — pure domain functions with string and minute math
inventory.rationale: Guarantees schedule calculations do not present timetable departures as live GPS.

inventory.v4_backend_truth_alignment: PERFECT — 23 canonical categories, 30 districts, distance thresholds
inventory.test_coverage: Requires dedicated test expansion in M0.5
inventory.rationale: Offline search filter parity across all 204 catalog items.

inventory.v4_backend_truth_alignment: PERFECT — ProvenanceSource, DataTier, ClaimType enums match docs/v4/PRODUCT.md truth model
inventory.swift_interop: EXCELLENT — compiles to native Swift enums
inventory.rationale: Foundational truth contract governing UI badges (Verified Official, Scheduled, Live, Estimated).

inventory.v4_backend_truth_alignment: PERFECT — Sealed hierarchy: LiveDeviceLocation, PermissionDenied, ReferenceOrigin, Unavailable
inventory.swift_interop: EXCELLENT — compiles to Swift class hierarchy
inventory.rationale: Prevents defaulting to Master Canteen as if it were real user location.

inventory.v4_backend_truth_alignment: PERFECT — Prohibits 0°C or fake Sunny defaults; requires explicit Unavailable or Stale with timestamp
inventory.swift_interop: EXCELLENT — clean data class with nullable properties
inventory.rationale: Prevents AI or UI hallucinating weather values.

inventory.v4_backend_truth_alignment: PERFECT — Multi-rider consensus threshold algorithm for stop candidate promotion
inventory.rationale: Core domain logic for crowdsourced transit stop validation in M20.

inventory.v4_backend_truth_alignment: GOOD — String constants for UI keys across English and Odia
inventory.rationale: Guarantees localization key parity across Android and iOS.

inventory.v4_backend_truth_alignment: GOOD — Dual-script names for 30 Odisha districts and transit hubs in Odia and English
ABSTRACT INTERFACES — Repository contracts defined in Kotlin
inventory.swift_interop: MODERATE — Swift protocols work better natively in iOS rather than Kotlin interfaces
inventory.rationale: Keep as reference for repository methods, but native Swift/Kotlin interfaces are preferred on each platform.

inventory.v4_backend_truth_alignment: PERFECT — Pure KMP configuration targeting JVM, Android, and iOS (XCFramework)
inventory.rationale: Build configuration for the shared core.

inventory.v4_backend_truth_alignment: PERFECT — Dependency catalog with Kotlin 2.0.20, AGP 8.6.0, Compose BOM 2024.09.02, Room 2.6.1
inventory.rationale: Version catalog reused for future Android module.
Will be updated at M5 to include :android when Android project is bootstrapped.

summary_verdict: All 12 core KMP domain files retain their REUSE_CONTRACT status with proven alignment to V4 backend truth. Repositories.kt is reclassified as REFERENCE_ONLY. Zero legacy code deleted; zero unneeded abstraction added.
